content: The successful execution confirms that the 'hp:run' level text concatenation strategy is robust for HWPX placeholder replacement. Key success factors include: 1) Normalizing placeholders by merging all 'hp:t' elements within a single 'hp:run' before replacement to bypass XML fragmentation. 2) Aggressively removing 'hp:linesegarray' elements to force the HWP viewer to re-render the modified text. 3) Budget normalization (stripping commas but keeping currency symbols) and dynamic month span calculation (end_date - start_date) were handled correctly in the transformation script.
